meta_description: Browser-based PDF presenter console (pdfpc-compatible). No install, no upload.
hero_lead: A browser-based presenter console. No install, no upload.
howitworks_step1_body: No install, no upload. Files stay on your device. pdfpc config files supported.
howitworks_step2_body: A presenter console with notes and timer, synced to a fullscreen audience display.
howitworks_step3_body: Notes, timer, laser pointer, pen, and blackout — all keyboard-driven.
library_help_advanced_body: Stores only a pointer to the file, so you always open the latest version.
library_help_standard_body: Saves the file content into the browser. If you update the original file later, opening from history shows the saved snapshot, not the new version.
library_help_note_overwrite: * Files with the same name overwrite older history entries.
library_help_note_off: * Turning off "Save history" disables history in both modes.
library_empty_hint: No recent files yet. Drop a PDF above to start.
presenter_error_permission_denied: Permission denied. Please grant access again.
presenter_error_config_name_mismatch: Config file name does not match the PDF (example.pdf ↔ example.pdfpc).
presenter_error_config_permission: Permission for the config file was denied.
presenter_error_no_file_permission: No permission to open the file.
presenter_error_pdfpc_pairing: pdfpc must have the same name as the PDF (e.g. example.pdf ↔ example.pdfpc).
presenter_missing_not_found_title: The specified file was not found
presenter_missing_back_message: Go back to the home page and select a file again.
presentation_missing_back_message: Go back to the home page and select a file again.
presentation_pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Reopen the presenter window or check that the same file name is open.
presentation_config_load_failed: Could not load the configuration. Confirm that the presenter window is open with the same file.
presentation_pdf_load_failed: Could not load the PDF file. Confirm that the presenter window is open with the same file.
presentation_connecting_hint: Confirm that the presenter window is open.
kb_slide_jump_mode_hint: Then type digits and press Enter
overview_footer_help: Tab: toggle · Esc: close · Click: select
